headlines.summary_en: An Economic Daily article states that personal housing loan rates have dropped to the "2% range"? headlines.title: 从行业倡议到立法破局 反内卷进入制度化治理新阶段
headlines.summary: 2024年7月，中共中央政治局会议首次提出防止“内卷式”恶性竞争。两年多来，“内卷式”竞争治理持续进阶，从个别行业发起自律倡议，演进为制度规则、行业标准、监管执法多管齐下的综合治理格局。综合整治“内卷式”竞争，既是攻坚战，也是持久战。2026年7月召开的中共中央政治局会议提出“继续综合整治‘内卷式’竞争”，强调将“制定实施全国统一大市场建设条例”。受访专家认为，随着未来全国统一大市场建设条例出台，整治“内卷式”竞争将进入制度化长效治理的关键阶段。

headlines.title_en: From industry initiatives to legislative breakthroughs, anti-involution enters new stage of institutionalized governance
headlines.summary_en: In July 2024, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee first proposed preventing 'involution-style' vicious competition. Over the past two years, governance of 'involution-style' competition has advanced, evolving from voluntary initiatives in individual industries to a comprehensive governance framework combining institutional rules, industry standards, and regulatory enforcement. Comprehensively rectifying 'involution-style' competition is both a tough battle and a long-term effort. The Political Bureau meeting in July 2026 proposed 'continuing comprehensive rectification of involution-style competition' and emphasized 'formulating and implementing regulations for a unified national market'. Experts believe that with the upcoming introduction of these regulations, rectification of 'involution-style' competition will enter a key phase of institutionalized long-term governance.

headlines.title_en: AI drives semiconductor sector boom, two major wafer foundries post record Q2 revenue
headlines.summary_en: On the evening of August 13, SMIC and Hua Hong Semiconductor both released Q2 results. Both wafer foundries saw revenue and gross margins grow YoY and QoQ, with revenue hitting record highs, reflecting the semiconductor industry's high prosperity. Both foundries' optimistic Q3 guidance suggests the industry boom is likely to continue. AI remains the strongest growth driver for semiconductors, with demand expanding from memory and logic to power, analog, and other product areas. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 五年期大额存单重启 银行意图稳长期负债
headlines.summary: 在停售数月后，四家国有大型银行近期陆续重启五年期大额存单发行，产品最高年利率为1.6%。中国证券报记者实地走访多家银行营业网点发现，五年期大额存单额度充足，投资者认购热情平淡，银行客户经理推广意愿也不强。业内人士认为，国有大行重启五年期大额存单，意在锁定长期资金，对冲巨量定期存款到期压力，拉长负债久期，这是利率下行周期稳定负债的阶段性操作，并非存款利率触底反弹的信号。受制于净息差持续承压，银行业难以大规模发行长期限大额存单。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Five-year large-denomination certificates of deposit resume, banks aim to stabilize long-term liabilities
headlines.summary_en: After suspending sales for several months, four major state-owned banks have recently resumed issuing five-year large-denomination certificates of deposit (CDs), with top annual rates of 1.6%. A China Securities Journal reporter visiting bank branches found ample quota for five-year CDs, tepid investor demand, and weak promotion by bank relationship managers. Industry insiders believe the state-owned banks are restarting five-year CDs to lock in long-term funds, offset pressure from maturing large time deposits, and extend liability duration—a phased measure to stabilize liabilities during a rate decline cycle, not a signal of deposit rates bottoming out. Due to sustained net interest margin pressure, banks cannot issue long-term CDs on a large scale. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title_en: Nearly 100 companies complete private placements this year, raising over 169 billion yuan in total
headlines.summary_en: This year, the A-share market has continued to recover, with significantly increased activity in private placement market. Wind data shows: based on issue dates, 98 A-share companies have completed share placements this year, up 28.95% from 76 in the same period last year; total fundraising reached 169.286 billion yuan, up 54.13% YoY excluding four bank placements last year to replenish working capital. As of the close on August 13, 64 companies' latest stock prices (adjusted) exceeded their placement prices, with the highest up nearly 280%. The remaining 34 companies' stock prices have temporarily fallen below placement issue prices, accounting for about 35%. (Shanghai Securities News)
